**Voice:** Eric, Smooth & Trustworthy (ElevenLabs `cjVigY5qzO86Huf0OWal`, `eleven_multilingual_v2`, stability 0.5, similarity boost 0.8, style 0.15, speaker boost on; the same settings on every line). Generated by `tools/tts.mjs` (`/with-timestamps`, so word times come from the TTS, not Whisper).

## Line 1 — One key stops (Frame 1)

**Time:** 0 – 6s
**Source:** /pool figure, row "One key, alone" → `429 rate limited`.

    One API key. One provider. Sooner or later, it stops.

## Line 2 — AnyRouter routes (Frame 2)

**Time:** 6 – 22s
**Source:** home figure ("When an upstream is rate limited or down, AnyRouter tries the next one. You get one answer and one bill."), llms.txt failover line.

    AnyRouter is one API in front of every model. Your agent sends one request. AnyRouter picks an upstream. If it is rate limited or down, AnyRouter tries the next one. One answer, one bill.

## Line 3 — One key, every model (Frame 3)

**Time:** 22 – 33s
**Source:** home H1 subline ("OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible. Switch models, keep your code."), llms.txt ("Catalog: 400+ models").

    It speaks the OpenAI and Anthropic formats. Change the base URL, and keep your code. One key reaches more than four hundred models.

## Line 4 — The shared Pool (Frame 4)

**Time:** 33 – 55s
**Source:** /pool ("One free key runs out. A pool of them doesn't.", "AnyRouter balances requests across the keys, rotates them and skips any key that is rate limited", "Add one valid free-tier key and you get the Go plan, with $0 on requests the Pool serves.").

    A free tier is small. One key, alone, hits the limit and stops. So people add free-tier keys to one shared Pool. AnyRouter spreads requests across the keys, and skips any key that is rate limited. Add one valid free-tier key, and you get the Go plan, with zero dollars on requests the Pool serves.

## Line 5 — The MCP gateway (Frame 5)

**Time:** 55 – 68s
**Source:** /mcp ("One URL for AnyRouter's tools and every MCP server you connect.", endpoint, connector list with Exa, Firecrawl, Keenable, GitHub).

    Tools work the same way. The AnyRouter MCP gateway gives your agent one URL and one key, for every MCP server you connect. Exa, Firecrawl, Keenable, GitHub, and more.

## Line 6 — The anyr CLI (Frame 6)

**Time:** 68 – 84s
**Source:** real PTY captures in `capture/cli/` (installer, `anyr claude --dry-run`, `anyr mcp add cursor --print`), `anyr --help`.

    For coding, install the any R command line tool with one line. Sign in once. Then any R claude starts Claude Code through AnyRouter. Codex and opencode work the same way. For Cursor, any R MCP add cursor connects the gateway.

## Line 7 — Close (Frame 7)

**Time:** 84 – 92s
**Source:** home H1 "Every LLM. One API.", /pool.

    One key. Every model. A shared Pool for free models. Start at any router dot dev.
